title: Uruguayan Molasses Cake
description: A traditional Uruguayan dessert, characterized by its rich, sweet flavor and springy texture. This recipe makes one large cake that serves 8-10 people.

ingredients.name: grated fresh ginger
ingredients.notes: use 1 tsp if you don't like strong ginger flavor

ingredients.name: molasses
ingredients.notes: dark or light, whichever you prefer

instructions: Combine flour, ginger, and yeast in a medium bowl. Whisk until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together molasses, butter, sugar, eggs, and egg yolk until smooth.
Add the dry mixture to the wet mixture and stir until just combined.
Add the warm milk and mix until the batter is smooth and elastic.
Knead the dough for 10-12 minutes until it becomes shiny and slightly sticky.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1-2 hours, or until doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and shape it into a round or oblong cake. Place it on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Let the cake cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely.
